## ✅ Checklist

- [ ] I have read [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md)
- [ ] `gofmt -l .` returns nothing
- [ ] `go vet ./...` passes
- [ ] `go build .` succeeds
- [ ] I tested both languages (fa / en) if UI changed
- [ ] I tested mobile breakpoints (700px, 480px, 360px) if UI changed
- [ ] Every new string has keys in **both** `I18N.fa` and `I18N.en`
- [ ] No new external dependencies (unless discussed first)
